name: Mebanazine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United Kingdom, first in 1975 — for liver harm

summary: Mebanazine was pulled from the market in the United Kingdom starting in 1975 because of liver harm [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, it received low scores for both liver and heart risks [M]. Related medicines have also been removed from shelves for causing liver harm, nerve and brain harm, and heart harm [3][4].
